The '''Ploong sounder''' was a large speaker used to amplify the sounds of the [[Bandfill/Legends|bandfill]], and was thus commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] bands, such as [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]].
